items.title: I tried Tovala’s smart oven for two weeks — here’s whether it beats takeout
items.summary: Tovala offers both a smart oven and a meal-delivery service. Its meals come with QR codes that you scan using the app, allowing the oven to automatically follow the cooking instructions.
